2610.02928.title: Discriminating Fixture Coverage in Agent-Infrastructure Verification Suites
2610.02928.paper_summary: Invariant suites and runtime monitors increasingly gate agent deployment decisions, and the evidence offered for any particular suite is almost always a single observation: it passes an implementation believed correct and fails one believed broken. We measure what that observation is worth. Applying mutation analysis to an invariant suite for a multi-session agent state-projection layer, we first find that this standard validation certifies a suite in which a first-order mutant removing event-identity deduplication survives every check. We then freeze the repaired twelve-check suite, record its hash, and run it once against ten mutants specified by an adversarial reader who designed none of its fixtures: it kills five. Instrumenting the five survivors against the reference shows they fail in two distinct ways, not one. Three are never activated, because no fixture supplies an input on which the mutated code behaves differently at all. The other two corrupt internal state that no oracle in the suite can observe. The two modes need different repairs, and neither is visible from a pass/fail report. Treating the missing inputs as a coverage question, we enumerate seven discriminating dimensions of the input space, register in advance which are uncovered and which survivors they should explain, and add one fixture per uncovered dimension while reusing the existing oracles verbatim. All five survivors then die, each to the check written for its predicted dimension. We report this as a repair result on the same challenge set rather than a second held-out estimate, and give the artifact, including the frozen hash, the registered predictions, all mutants and the run logs, so the distinction is checkable.
2610.02928.paper_summary_zh: 不變套件和運行時監控器越來越多地影響代理部署決策，而對於任何特定套件所提供的證據幾乎總是一個單一的觀察：它通過了一個被認為是正確的實現，並且失敗於一個被認為是壞的實現。我們衡量這個觀察的價值。對於多會話代理狀態投影層的不變套件應用突變分析，我們首先發現這一標準驗證證明了一個套件，其中一個去除事件身份去重的第一階突變體通過了每一個檢查。我們然後凍結修復過的十二檢查套件，記錄其哈希值，並對一個由對抗性讀者指定的十個突變體運行一次，該讀者並未設計其任何裝置：它殺死了五個。對這五個存活者進行儀器化與參考相比，顯示它們以兩種不同的方式失敗，而不是一種。三個從未被激活，因為沒有裝置提供一個輸入，使得突變的代碼在任何方面的行為都不同。其他兩個則破壞了內部狀態，這在套件中沒有任何神諭可以觀察到。這兩種模式需要不同的修復，且從通過/失敗報告中都無法看出。將缺失的輸入視為一個覆蓋問題，我們列舉了輸入空間的七個區分維度，提前註冊哪些是未覆蓋的，哪些存活者應該解釋，並在每個未覆蓋的維度中添加一個裝置，同時逐字重用現有的神諭。然後所有五個存活者都死去，每個都對其預測維度的檢查作出反應。我們將此報告為同一挑戰集上的修復結果，而不是第二次保留的估計，並提供工件，包括凍結的哈希、註冊的預測、所有突變體和運行日誌，以便區分是可檢查的。
2610.02928.author: Xin Xu et.al.
